migration_rules: Do not rename a module solely because it is internal.
Do not move a module into Shared until declaration-level consumers are audited.

Derive candidate ownership from the union of trust-declared gates, tracked export configurations, and the paper registry; absence from an export configuration is a disposition requiring review, not evidence that a gate is unowned.

Before replacing a module exported by another area, compare its declaration set and every reverse consumer; byte identity inside the active closure is insufficient if declarations outside that closure would disappear.
A paper registry alias or secondary entry point shares its named formal_surface_of package and does not create a duplicate Lean ownership boundary.
Q11 and Q16 certificate modules use only their branded TavisRuddFiniteGeom.Certificates namespaces; no RelativeConicArcs compatibility namespace remains in either certificate package.
Generated certificate namespace migrations use the owning tracked generator or a tracked hash-guarded transformer over the canonical generated Lean source; generated modules are never hand-edited.
Every PaperInterface and shared public interface gets its own exact verification target.
Every mapping that changes a paper-facing Lean module synchronizes finitegeom and all affected paper repositories before closeout.
